description: S023 and S043 bodies verify the 31 January Tarapacá/Iquique stoppage, multiple blockades and related marches, but give no observed count for any 31 January gathering. A port-guild leader says actions are needed to attract government attention; the state target is clearer than the crowd threshold. Cooperativa’s 300 taxi drivers were expected and its 40 vehicles were planned, not turnout. The story also reports tomatoes thrown at the Alto Hospicio municipality without clarifying target/impact. A 200-person Laguna Verde-to-delegation report appears in a 1 February 12:19 update and lacks a verified January onset or episode link.
required_followup: Keep the candidate pending_unit with threshold and event-unit boundaries unresolved. Under a new all-eight freeze and fresh exact gates, seek observed counts for each specific gathering, the physical end, any completed state response, the target/impact of tomato throwing, and a dated account of the Laguna Verde action. Never transfer passenger effects, planned vehicles, expected drivers, or 30 January attendance.

description: BioBioChile S063 body reports a 28 January protest in Temuco by communities from Nueva Imperial, Cholchol, Galvarino and Temuco against a Juan Sutil-backed reservoir project. It gives the route from outside the Superintendencia del Medio Ambiente to the Regional Delegation of La Araucanía and stated project grievances, but no attendance count or clear demand to a Chilean state actor. The 50-person threshold and state-directed target remain unresolved. S063 body scope/ref/hash and access outcome are reconciled in the source card and history/window_body_reads.jsonl; S060/S067/S070 remain search-only and may duplicate this action, so do not merge them without episode-level confirmation.
required_followup: Resolve the actual attendance/50-person threshold, whether there was a demand directed to a domestic state actor, exact onset/end and any state response, and whether S060/S067/S070 describe this same gathering. No further body request is authorized in this closed window.
